001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.math.BigInteger;
008
009/**
010 * History log record Time Change, opCode 13, size 26.
011 *
012 * <br>
013 *
014 * 
015 * <table border='1'>
016 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
017 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>13</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
018 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Time Change"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
019 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_TIME_CHANGED"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
020 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTidepool</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
021 * </table>
022 */
023@HistoryLogProps(
024    opCode = 13,
025    displayName = "Time Change",
026    internalName = "LID_TIME_CHANGED",
027    usedByTidepool = true
028)
029public class TimeChangedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
030    
031    private long timePrior;
032    private long timeAfter;
033    private long rawRTC;
034    
035    public TimeChangedHistoryLog() {}
036    public TimeChangedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long timePrior, long timeAfter, long rawRTC) {
037        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
038        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, timePrior, timeAfter, rawRTC);
039        this.timePrior = timePrior;
040        this.timeAfter = timeAfter;
041        this.rawRTC = rawRTC;
042        
043    }
044
045    public TimeChangedHistoryLog(long timePrior, long timeAfter, long rawRTC) {
046        this(0, 0, timePrior, timeAfter, rawRTC);
047    }
048
049    public int typeId() {
050        return 13;
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * <table border="1">
055     * <caption>Parsed fields for TimeChangedHistoryLog:</caption>
056     * <tr><td><code>timePrior</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>timeAfter</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>rawRTC</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
059     * </table>
060     */
061    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
062        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
063        this.cargo = raw;
064        parseBase(raw);
065        this.timePrior = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
066        this.timeAfter = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
067        this.rawRTC = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
068        
069    }
070
071    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long timePrior, long timeAfter, long rawRTC) {
072        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
073            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(13, 0),
074            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
075            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
076            Bytes.toUint32(timePrior), 
077            Bytes.toUint32(timeAfter), 
078            Bytes.toUint32(rawRTC)));
079    }
080    public long getTimePrior() {
081        return timePrior;
082    }
083    public long getTimeAfter() {
084        return timeAfter;
085    }
086    public long getRawRTC() {
087        return rawRTC;
088    }
089    
090}
